text:
Sam: Quick heads-up 1: procurement put ReconMate and InvoicePilot on the shortlist for our month-end invoice reconciliation project. Need answers on Netsuite connector, delta-detection logic, retention, and exit provisions before we commit to a pilot.

Elena: ReconMate demo looked solid but their connector required an intermediate SFTP step. Not ideal for realtime.

Carlos: InvoicePilot claims native Netsuite via SuiteTalk and incremental syncs. We should verify delta detection to avoid double-processing historical invoices.

Finance-bot: Reminder: include expected annualized run-rate and any one-time onboarding fees in vendor evaluations. >$15k/yr needs VP approval.

procurement: @vendor-erin can you clarify InvoicePilot's Netsuite approach and any rate limits for API calls? We need throughput to handle ~25k invoices/day during close windows.

vendor-erin: Hi team 1: InvoicePilot uses SuiteTalk for initial pull and then optional webhook + change-token consumer for deltas. Rate limiting is 500 API calls/min per account; we recommend batch windows for high-volume backfills.

vendor-erin: We also provide a connector that runs in-customer VPC (container) for enterprise customers to avoid hitting SuiteTalk limits; that's part of Enterprise plan.

Sam: Enterprise connector sounds promising. Is the container image signed? Any requirement for outbound traffic?

vendor-erin: The image is signed and we publish checksums. The connector makes outbound HTTPS to our ingestion endpoint unless you choose air-gapped mode (on-prem queue + file drop).

Elena: Important: we cannot expose raw PII to vendor endpoints. Do you support field-level encryption or tokenization during ingest?

vendor-erin: We support client-side tokenization via a local transform lambda pre-ingest; field-level encryption is available as an add-on.

Carlos: Pricing: can you share sample pricing profiles for 1M invoices/year vs 250k? Also curious about overage behavior and month-to-month flexibility.

vendor-erin: Pricing tiers: Starter $600/mo (up to 25k/mo), Scale $1,800/mo (up to 250k/mo), Enterprise custom pricing for >250k. Overage billed at tiered rates; Enterprise can get committed usage discounts and monthly true-ups. Short-term pilots can be month-to-month.

procurement: Any one-time onboarding fees?

vendor-erin: Standard onboarding $2,000 (mapping, QA). Enterprise has optional managed onboarding (PO-based) for $8k.

Finance-bot: Note: one-time fees + first-year run-rate estimate required for budget card.

Sam: Contract terms: what's the minimum term and termination for convenience? Also need data egress/return policy at termination.

vendor-erin: Standard 12-month term with 60-day termination for convenience after initial quarter. Data export is provided in CSV/NDJSON; we offer a one-time data export service ($500) or can do a full DB snapshot for Enterprise. We retain raw logs for 90 days by default.

Legal: We need to ensure DPA, audit rights, and a clause about returning or deleting customer data within 30 days of termination. Also KMS integration for BYOK if required.

vendor-erin: BYOK and KMS available on Enterprise plan; DPA templates shared upon request.

Carlos: Operational SLAs: during close windows we need sub-1s reconciliation lookups from our checkout service. Are there regional endpoints and latency numbers?

vendor-erin: We have US/EU endpoints. Typical 95th p95 is 120-350ms for lookup calls; under sustained 5k RPS spikes we throttle to protect overall system. For sub-1s 99th, Enterprise includes guaranteed bandwidth and dedicated capacity.

Eng-ops: If we need dedicated capacity, what's the lead time and how is it provisioned?

vendor-erin: Dedicated capacity requires a 30-day lead time and a provisioning request. It can be on shared infra with reserved capacity or a single-tenant cluster (Enterprise).

Elena: Can you share a sample mapping CSV and an example API call for delta imports?

vendor-erin: Sample mapping: https://downloads.invocepilot.example/samples/mapping.csv. Delta import example:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.invoicepilot.example/v1/imports/delta \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \\
  -F "file=@delta.csv.gz" \\
  -F "mode=upsert" \\
  -F "dedupe_key=external_id"
```

procurement: Can you provide a sandbox account and a small sample dataset for us to run our parser? Also need SOC2 report and any ISO certifications.

vendor-erin: Sandbox created, credential DM'd to @procurement. SOC2 Type II and ISO 27001 attestation available.

Finance-bot: Reminder: if pilot includes more than $3k in vendor labor, flag for budget review.

Sam: Proposed plan: 10-day pilot for each vendor. Measure: ingest error rate, time-to-first-reconcile, false-positive matches on duplicates, integration effort (hours), and full-cost projection for 3 years. Owners: I1: Sam -> ReconMate POC, Elena -> InvoicePilot POC, Carlos -> cost/runbook analysis.

procurement: I'll track approvals and draft a short SOW for the onboarding scope to keep one-time fees predictable.

Eng-ops: I'll set up load tests (start with 200 RPS soak, then 2k spike) and a reconciliation checker to validate dedupe logic. Need sandbox API keys.

vendor-erin: Happy to support the load tests. For high-throughput tests we'll provide a temporary uplift to rate limits from our side for the pilot window.

Legal: If either pilot looks promising, I'll start a redline pass on their standard SaaS agreement and add export/retention/KMS addenda.

Sam: Great. Let's reconvene with POC outcomes two weeks from now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
